text: DSH Project Memory（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为项目开发提供跨会话的持久记忆。它接入 DSH 工具、任务命令、后台索引监视和 Web 任务面板，将项目文档切块、代码符号、经验记录与任务状态保存在项目目录，并通过混合检索返回带路径和行号的引用。主要功能包括索引 PDF、Markdown 和文本文件，索引代码仓库，按问题查询记忆，保存或删除经验条目，以及续接和归档跨会话任务。适合需要在会话切换或上下文压缩后继续开发、查找项目资料的 DSH 用户。默认把数据存入项目内的 .dsh-project-memory；无需额外 API Key。

DSH Project Memory is a Web plugin for persistent project context. Its tools index documents and code, search with file citations, save experience notes, and manage tasks across sessions. A watcher can refresh indexes. Data stays in the project memory directory; no extra API key is needed.
想让 DSH 在新会话里接着上次的项目任务做。
有没有办法把项目文档和代码索引起来后按问题查找？
让 DSH 记住某个 bug 的解决办法，之后遇到类似情况能搜到。
我想给 PDF、Markdown 和文本文件建立本地可检索索引。
DSH 会话压缩后总忘记项目背景，怎么保留关键记忆？
如何查看、切换或归档之前关联的开发任务？
How can I search my project files and code from a DSH session?
I want DSH to remember project tasks and lessons between sessions.
DSH Project Memory 的功能「文档索引」：把 PDF、Markdown 和文本文档加入项目记忆索引。通过 index_doc 工具指定文档路径，之后可用 query_memory 按问题检索并取得引用。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「仓库索引」：扫描项目文件并索引代码符号，供后续检索。调用 index_repo 工具指定项目根目录，可结合持续监视更新索引。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「记忆查询」：按自然语言问题检索文档、符号、经验、洞察或任务条目。调用 query_memory 指定查询及可选类别，结果包含来源路径和行号。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「经验记录」：通过 remember 或 save_lesson 保存问题、修复和经验条目；forget 可按 ID 或关键词移除记录，便于后续搜索复用。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「跨会话任务」：将 DSH todo 与项目任务记录关联，支持列出、选择、归档任务，并从 /tasks 工作流命令打开任务面板。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「自动注入相关记忆」：在会话步骤中查找匹配项目记忆，并将相关条目作为上下文加入请求；配置可控制自动上下文行为。
DSH Project Memory 的功能「索引监视」：watch_repo 可登记或取消项目目录的监视，后台监视器按配置间隔检查变化并更新索引。
DSH Project Memory 使用前须知：索引和任务记忆默认写入项目目录下的 .dsh-project-memory，memoryDir 可更改此目录；插件不要求额外 API Key。（见 src/index.js:27）

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · dsh-project-memory：A persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Underneath sits a **hybrid index**: document chunks, code symbols, experience notes and insights each form a layer, scored per layer and merged into one ranking. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. Data survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · dsh-project-memory：> The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Installation：The plugin relies only on stable public APIs declared through peerDependencies.

```bash
cd dsh-project-memory && dsh plugin --profile web add . -w
```

The `-w` (workspace-root) flag is required: the profile directory is a pnpm workspace root, and pnpm rejects `add` there without it. From elsewhere, use the same command with an absolute path.

The plugin is also published on npm as a scoped package:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory -w
```

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Installation：Each indexed project has its own store at `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/`. It keeps itself out of git by default — there is nothing to add to your `.gitignore`. Global-scope entries are kept outside the project in `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`; point `insight.globalFile` elsewhere to move it.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Usage：The tools below are **invoked by the agent**, not typed by the user. In the chat, just ask naturally — e.g. "index this project" or "what does the auth module do?" — or simply keep working, and the agent calls the matching tool automatically. By default files are indexed the moment the model reads them, so memory fills in while you work. `watch_repo` keeps explicitly-watched roots fresh in the background; `index_repo` forces a full backfill (unchanged files are skipped).

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Usage：In a git work tree the corpus is whatever `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` lists — tracked files plus untracked files that are not ignored — so `.gitignore`, nested rules included, decides what gets remembered. Hidden paths (any path segment starting with `.`) and the built-in ignore list (`node_modules`, `dist`, …) are skipped in both modes; a directory that is not a git work tree falls back to a plain walk with the same filter. Lazy indexing applies the same check when a file first enters the store; a file that is already indexed is refreshed on later reads without asking git again — if `.gitignore` starts excluding it, the `index_repo` / `watch_repo` scan drops it. An explicit `index_doc` bypasses both `.gitignore` and the hidden-path filter, but still respects `roots.exclude`, readability and the size limit, and its entry survives later scan passes for as long as the file exists.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Usage：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index_doc file_path` | Index one document (PDF/MD/txt): chunk, summarize deterministically, and store with a `path:line` citation. Unchanged files are skipped. |
| `index_repo root` | Index a whole project: documents get deterministic summaries, code files get a token-free symbol table. Incremental and self-healing: the store follows the file listing, so deleted, ignored or moved files are dropped (an entry created by an explicit `index_doc` is kept while its file still exists), and documents are cross-linked to symbols. A non-existent or excluded root is rejected before anything is written. |
| `watch_repo root` | Enable automatic refresh: a background poll detects new and changed files and re-indexes only those. A watched root is recorded in that project's store, so it resumes when dsh starts there; a non-existent or excluded root is refused, roots that disappear are dropped rather than re-created. |
| `memory_stats root` | Show what the store contains: totals, last index time, and the per-file list sorted by recency. Background index failures (watch or lazy, per root, most recent 50) are reported along

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Usage：`/tasks` appears in the web `/` menu inside an icon-bearing **Workflow** group, with three view entries — Tasks / Project Memory / Global Memory (labelled in the UI language). It is the plugin's only registered command; every other action rides it as a sub-verb driven by card buttons.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · How it works：- **Volatility** — context is ephemeral; it is lost when a session is compacted.
- **Persistence** — the **memory** is stored on disk and survives compaction and new sessions.
- **Compactness** — one bounded declaration line per symbol, and a ≤300-char summary plus a bounded term set per document chunk. Doc→symbol links are not stored; they are computed at read time.
- **Verifiability** — **recalls** carry a `path:line` citation where applicable, so the agent can confirm details against the source.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · How it works：With default lazy indexing, building the **memory** does not require an upfront scan: files are memorized as the model reads them, so the **memory** grows to cover what has been worked with; `index_repo` or a watched root can cover the rest. Re-reading an unchanged file is a no-op, so the **memory** stays fresh with minimal ongoing overhead.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · How it works：Project- and task-scope memory is stored per project and follows the codebase: changed files are re-extracted by content hash, deleted files are removed. Experience notes are ordinary `kind: 'experience'` entries in `insights.json`: recallable, deduplicated, and eligible for the same gated hint channel as lessons.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Design：```
.dsh-project-memory/
  format.json      layout marker (v2, sharded)
  shards/          one self-describing JSON per indexed source file — writes touch only dirty shards
  watch.json       watched roots

Global-scope entries are not stored under the project: they live in `insight.globalFile` (default `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`) so every project sees them.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Design：- **Incremental** — a content hash per file; only changed files are re-extracted.
- **Cross-linking** — a returned document chunk resolves the symbols it mentions against the **current** symbol table and appends them as `references`, so a doc indexed before its symbols still links correctly.
- **Query expansion** — when enabled, `query_memory` asks the LLM to rewrite the query into several variants (synonyms, EN/CN, identifier guesses) and merges the scores; when off, queries never touch the LLM. Indexing itself is model-free.
- **Consistency** — the fact layer follows the codebase (hash re-extract / remove-on-delete); experience entries are updated through the same supersede and `forget` paths as other insights. Writes take a cross-process directory lock (`.write.lock`) around a short read-modify-write, so two dsh instances can share one project store: shards converge by `indexedAt`, a save that cannot get the lock is retried and flushed again at exit, failures stay silent by default (`DSH_PROJECT_MEMORY_DEBUG=1` prints one diagnostic line), and entries deleted by another process are not resurrected by a stale in-memory snapshot.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Architecture (Task Panel)：```
TaskPanel (Container)
├── task-data-store  (server data, cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel)
├── task-ui-store    (local UI state, localStorage)
├── task-hooks       (useTaskDrag, useTaskEdit)

The workflow panel is collapsible, adapts to dsh and theme plugin styles, and offers four card styles.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `memoryDir` | `.dsh-project-memory` | store directory inside each indexed root. Must stay a relative path inside the root: `.`, `..`, any `..` segment or an absolute path falls back to the default with one warning (otherwise the store lands outside the root, or on the root itself and self-ignores the whole repository) |
| `chunkChars` / `maxChunksPerFile` | 3000 / 40 | max chars per document chunk, max chunks per document |
| `maxFileSizeMb` | 10 | skip documents (incl. PDF) and code files larger than this (MB); entries of an already-indexed file that later grows past the cap are dropped on the next scan / watch pass; see the per-file memory budget below |
| `maxPdfPages` | 1000 | PDF page cap |
| `maxOutputChars` | 8000 | cap for `query_memory` result text (chars) |
| `lazyIndexing` | true | index files the moment the model reads them |
| `autoIndexOnFirstUse` | false | full scan of the current working directory on plugin load (opt-in) |
| `watch` / `watchInterval` | true / 30 | background refresh; base poll interval in seconds (polls stay quiet while a turn is running — a 5-minute fa

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：The two most relevant switches are `lazyIndexing` (index a file the moment the model reads it; default on) and `autoIndexOnFirstUse` (full scan of the current working directory on plugin load; default off). Lazily indexed project roots are automatically registered with the watcher, so changed files stay fresh without an explicit `watch_repo`.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**Root resolution.** In order: an explicit `root` argument; a registered root (`watch_repo`); the nearest ancestor with a VCS marker (`.git`/`.hg`/`.svn`) or a build/manifest marker (`package.json`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, …); the session working directory, unless it is on the excluded list. A file that matches none of these is not indexed.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：When the root comes from the working directory, the model gets one notice per session naming it and how to change it; mute with `autoContext.rootNotice: false`. Starting dsh in a container directory such as `~/workspace` therefore makes that directory the root, and memory spans everything beneath it up to the scan limit — start dsh inside the project for one store per project.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**Excluded directories.** By default, these are not used as a root, matched exactly (subdirectories are unaffected): the filesystem root, the home directory, temp directories — `os.tmpdir()` and the shared ones (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, `%TEMP%`, `%SystemRoot%\Temp`) — and system / package-manager prefixes (`/opt/homebrew` on POSIX; `%SystemRoot%`, `%ProgramFiles%`, `%ProgramData%` on Windows). A session in one of these runs without memory, with one line on stderr.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**Custom root lists.** The `roots` block overrides that decision. All three accept `~` / `~/...`; non-absolute entries are ignored with a one-time stderr warning (relative paths would resolve against the host cwd and are unpredictable); Windows is case-insensitive:

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：`deny` only decides whether the directory itself can be a root: when a parent is already a root, files under a denied child are still indexed by that parent — use `exclude` (or `.gitignore`, which the git-aware scan already honours) to drop the files too. Explicit `index_doc` also respects `exclude` and returns `Not indexed` for a file under it.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：Priority is `exclude` > `deny` > `allow` > built-in list. `allowUnsafeRoots: true` only releases the built-in list; `deny` / `exclude` still win. The same verdict is shared by explicit tool calls, lazy indexing, watch, the session audit trail and TaskBridge. Roots refused by the current policy are dropped from `watch.json` on startup. Configure under `config:` of `- id: project-memory`.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**Scan limits.** One pass covers at most `maxScanFiles` files (20000) and `maxScanDepth` directory levels (12). A truncated pass is reported in the `index_repo` result and logged once per root by the watcher, and it does not remove entries it did not reach. A directory that cannot be read (e.g. `EACCES`) counts as a truncated pass too and is named in the result: a read failure is not a deletion.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**Per-file memory budget.** `maxFileSizeMb` is a memory gate, not a disk-space preference. Indexing a file first materializes it — the whole buffer plus decoded text for code, or every PDF page's text plus the joined markdown for documents — and the peak scales with the file's size. Measured on this machine with `npm run bench:peak` (peak RSS fitted against disk size over a 1–50 MB ladder, one fresh process per point): **≈10×** for typical source code (1 declaration per ~1.4 KB), **≈22×** for symbol-dense code (1 per 220 B) and **≈20×** for a text-heavy PDF, on top of a ~52 MB process baseline plus a one-off ≈175 MB the first time a PDF is parsed. The 10 MB default therefore keeps a single file at roughly **+300 MB RSS** for code and **+370 MB** for a PDF; raising the cap raises that ceiling proportionally.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：The store lives in the tree it indexes and **ignores itself**: a `*` rule inside the store keeps it out of `git status` and `git add -A`, and means `git clean -fd` leaves it alone. To commit project memory deliberately, `git add -f .dsh-project-memory` — tracked files are not affected by ignore rules.

Settings live in the plugin's config object. To change them, add an override entry to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — for the web profile that is `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：```yaml
- id: project-memory
  config:
    lazyIndexing: true          # on: index files as the model reads them (default)
    autoIndexOnFirstUse: false  # off: no upfront full scan (default)

Only list the keys you want to change; the rest fall back to the plugin defaults. Verify the result with `dsh --profile web --dump-config`.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：**On the web profile, three of these keys also have a visual card.** It sits at **Plugins → Project memory → detail page → Common settings** (`plugins.bundle.config`, keyed by package name): `autoIndexOnFirstUse`, `watchInterval` (seconds) and `llmQueryExpansion`. Saving goes through the host's `settings` interface — the card is a projection of the same config the profile override above feeds, not a separate file. `watchInterval` and `llmQueryExpansion` take effect immediately (the poll timer is re-armed, the expansion flag is read per query); `autoIndexOnFirstUse` is a one-off startup action, so the card says "effective next start". Everything else — `memoryDir`, `roots.*`, scan caps, insight / reflection / autoContext — deliberately stays in the profile: those either move the store or need context a three-row card cannot carry, and there is no switch for background watching (turning it off only lets memory go stale). On a host that does not offer the `slots` / `configForms` / `locale` services the card registers nothing and logs one warning naming the missing piece, rather than disappearing silently. These three are resolv

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Toggling features：For a one-off run without editing the profile, pass the override as a CLI patch overlay:

```bash
dsh web --patch ./config.yml
```

where `config.yml` contains the same override block.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Measured on real projects (2026-10-13)：Four corpora, one Linux machine (Node 24.19), each run twice with the **second, warm-cache run** quoted. "Cold index" is a full index pass (walk + hash + extract + commit); "query" runs the shipped scorer over 100 sampled queries; "re-index 1 file" is the watch re-index core (read + extract + commit), which excludes the lazy path's root-resolution / `.gitignore` overhead.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Measured on real projects (2026-10-13)：| Corpus | Files / entries | Cold index | Cold load | Query p50 / p95 | Re-index 1 file | Store content / on disk | Heap after load |
|--------|-----------------|-----------|-----------|-----------------|-----------------|------------------------|-----------------|
| Frontend app (code only) | 289 / 2,142 | 246 ms | 8 ms | 0.76 / 1.4 ms | 0.3 ms | 0.66 MB / 1.52 MB | 6.3 MB |
| Docs workspace (Markdown + PDFs) | 249 / 977 | 705 ms | 10 ms | 1.8 / 5.5 ms | 0.4 ms | 1.31 MB / 1.84 MB | 6.8 MB |
| TypeScript monorepo, 3,000-file slice | 3,000 / 17,576 | 1.9 s | 70 ms | 9.2 / 18.9 ms | 1.9 ms | 10.9 MB / 18.9 MB | 22.7 MB |
| TypeScript monorepo, whole tree | 12,634 / 80,231 | 7.8 s | 278 ms | 40.6 / 74.8 ms | 7.2 ms | 42.0 MB / 75.7 MB | 75.2 MB |

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Measured on real projects (2026-10-13)：**How it scales.** Re-indexing a changed file costs O(file), not O(corpus) — 0.3–7.2 ms across every corpus above. Cold load (≈22 µs/file), query (≈0.5 µs/entry on the largest corpus) and resident heap (≈1.5 KB/entry once queried) grow linearly with the index, which keeps small and mid-size projects in the single-digit-millisecond range. Re-reading a file that is already indexed costs ≈0.01 ms: it stops after one `stat` plus a cached record lookup, with no read, no hash and no `git check-ignore`.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Measured on real projects (2026-10-13)：> `read+hash` depends on the OS page cache — 2.3 s cold vs 0.27 s warm on the 12,634-file tree — so the table quotes the warm figure.

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Synthetic Benchmark (Node 24.19, Linux)：| Scenario | Scale | Measured |
|----------|-------|----------|
| Full cold index | 5,000 files / 20k entries | 284 ms avg (p50 286) |
| Cold load | 5,000 files | 58 ms |
| Hot lazy re-index (single file) | 5k files | p50 2.5 ms / max 6.7 ms |
| query_memory (cached) | 5k files / 20k entries | p50 2.9 ms / p95 6.0 ms |
| query_memory (cached) | 1k files / 4k entries | p50 0.5 ms / p95 1.1 ms |
| Full cold index | 10,000 files / 40k entries | 558 ms avg (p50 540) |
| Cold load | 10,000 files | 117 ms |
| Hot lazy re-index (single file) | 10k files | p50 5.5 ms / max 8.4 ms |

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · Synthetic Benchmark (Node 24.19, Linux)：> Generated code (~4–5 symbols/file), measured 2026-10-13. Reproduce with `npm run bench:synthetic -- 5000` (`scripts/bench-synthetic.mjs`). Pure indexing overhead, no LLM calls. The first query after a write rebuilds the IDF cache (**141 ms at 40k entries**, 68 ms at 20k, 17 ms at 4k); later queries hit it. Those IDF figures are the pre-0.6.10 baseline — the 0.6.10 tokenizer rewrite makes that rebuild roughly a third faster on the same corpus (same-session A/B, numbers in the CHANGELOG).

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · dsh-project-memory：为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）agent 提供持久化的 **项目开发记忆**。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目，解决上下文失效。底层是一套**混合索引**：文档块、代码符号、经验笔记与洞察各占一层，召回时分层打分再合并排序。文档（PDF/Markdown/txt）与代码符号写入工作区独立存储，文档自动交叉链接至所提及的代码符号；经验笔记（问题 → 方案）自动去重，避免重复踩坑。数据跨会话压缩与交接保留，召回附带 `路径:行号` 可回源核实。

> 插件在磁盘上维护一份精简的项目**记忆**，每条记录指向具体的文件与行号；agent 需要快速了解项目时先查**记忆**，无需重读整个项目。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 特性：- **TaskBridge：跨会话开发任务** — 会话内的任务清单与触碰过的文件持久化为项目任务实体，工作流可以随时切走再续接，不必重新界定项目范围。关联文件按最近活跃排序（读取永远不越过写过的文件），续接时一眼看到该先看哪些。新会话通过 `list_tasks` → `select_task` 续接。委派给子代理的工作不会建档。宿主不提供会话事件时，任务工具仍可作为普通记录列表使用。
- **任务面板与编辑** — 卡片可拖拽，展示任务步骤与涉及文件，可折叠为迷你条或彻底隐藏；标题、步骤与状态支持行内编辑，与模型更新走同一条写回路径；四档外观风格只改材质、几何、字型与密度，颜色跟随宿主。面板默认隐藏，仅在显式唤起后出现；会话切换只后台同步，刷新页面不会自行打开；渲染错误有边界兜底，面板崩溃不会拖垮宿主。
- **文档记忆** — PDF、Markdown 与纯文本按块切分并生成摘要，索引期不调用模型。每条保留一段简短摘要供注入、一个有界的检索词集合，以及回源引用。
- **代码符号记忆** — 零依赖扫描器提取函数、类、方法、接口与类型别名及其签名，覆盖 JavaScript/TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、C/C++/C#、Java 与 shell。项目装了 `typescript` 时，可选第二层补推导返回类型、泛型与接口，后台执行、不阻塞索引。
- **读到即记忆、变更即刷新** — 默认开启懒索引：文件在模型实际读取的瞬间被记忆，记忆是正常工作的副产品，而不是额外的一次全量扫描。`index_repo` 或监听根目录可以覆盖其余文件；后台轮询只重记变更过的文件。
- **文档 ↔ 代码交叉链接** — 文档提及的符号，在查询该符号时一并带出。链接按**当前**符号表解算，不会过期。
- **混合召回** — 对文档、符号、经验笔记与 insight 排序召回，可选 LLM 查询扩展。`leanvec` 是 optionalDependency：默认装上并按余弦重排经验/洞察两层，没装或 `vectorDir: 'off'` 则退回纯词法。针对 CJK 增强：短语加分、同义词表，以及文档↔符号链接的词边界处理。俄语（西里尔）同样支持：切词 + 虚词表 + Snowball 词干，俄文查询能命中俄文条目，也参与去重。
- **经验笔记** — 记录问题 → 方案；相似问题覆盖而不重复，数量随项目规模有界，与教训走同一条注入通道：检索与自动注入都能带出。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 安装：插件只依赖通过 peerDependencies 声明的稳定公共 API。

```bash
cd dsh-project-memory && dsh plugin --profile web add . -w
```

`-w`（workspace-root）标志是必需的：profile 目录是 pnpm 工作区根目录，不带该标志 pnpm 会拒绝 add。其他目录下用同样的命令加上绝对路径即可。

插件同时发布在 npm 上（scoped 包）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory -w
```

每个被索引的项目在 `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/` 下有独立存储；它默认就把自己排除在 git 之外，`.gitignore` 无需任何添加。global 级条目单独存放于 `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`；可用 `insight.globalFile` 改到别处。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 用法：以下工具由 **agent 自动调用**，无需用户手动输入。在对话中直接说自然语言即可——例如「给这个项目建个索引」或「auth 模块是干嘛的」，或者正常开发即可——agent 会自动调用对应工具。默认开启「读到即索引」：模型读哪个文件，就顺便索引哪个文件，记忆在你干活的过程中自然积累。`watch_repo` 让显式监听的根目录在后台保持新鲜；`index_repo` 强制对项目做一次全量回填（未变更文件自动跳过）。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 用法：在 git 工作树里，语料就是 `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` 的清单——已跟踪文件，加上未被忽略的未跟踪文件——因此 `.gitignore`（含嵌套规则）决定什么会被记忆。隐藏路径（任一段以 `.` 开头）与内置忽略名单（`node_modules`、`dist` …）在两种模式下都跳过；不是 git 工作树的目录退回普通遍历，套用同一套过滤。「读到即索引」只在文件**首次入库**时套用同一判据；已入库的条目后续只刷新内容、不再问 git——等 `.gitignore` 开始排除它时，由 `index_repo` / `watch_repo` 的扫描清理摘掉。显式 `index_doc` 不受 `.gitignore` 与隐藏路径过滤限制，但仍服从 `roots.exclude`、可读性与体积上限，且只要文件还在，它的条目就能活过后续扫描清理。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 用法：| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `index_doc file_path` | 索引单个文档（PDF/MD/txt）：分块、确定性摘要，带 `路径:行号` 入库。未变更文件自动跳过。 |
| `index_repo root` | 索引整个项目：文档生成确定性摘要，代码文件生成零 token 符号表。增量更新，store 跟随文件清单：已删除、被忽略或移走的文件会被清理（显式 `index_doc` 的条目只要文件还在就保留）；文档与符号交叉链接。根目录不存在或在排除名单上时，会在写入任何内容前拒绝。 |
| `watch_repo root` | 启用自动刷新：后台轮询检测新增/变更文件，仅重抽这些文件。监听根会记在该项目的 store 里，在该项目下启动 dsh 时恢复监听；不存在或在排除名单上的根目录会被拒绝，已消失的根目录会被丢弃而不是被重新创建。 |
| `memory_stats root` | 查看记忆库内容：总量、最近索引时间，以及按时间排序的逐文件清单。后台索引失败（watch / 懒索引，按根记账、最多 50 条）也会一并报出，让「文件一直没进语料」可见。 |
| `query_memory query` | 对文档、符号、经验与 insight 执行排序检索，可选 LLM 查询扩展。`type` 选择层（`all` / `doc` / `symbol` / `experience` / `insight` / `task`）。返回带相对分数、引用或 insight id、以及文档→符号链接的结果。 |
| `list_tasks` | 列出本项目任务记录（含归档，带标记）。新会话/续接前先调用。 |
| `select_task` | 将会话绑定到某任务（此后 todo 清单与读文件同步进该任务）。按 `taskId` 精确绑定，或按 `title` 完全匹配（多个同名返回候选；无则新建）。带 title 可改名；自动解归档。 |
| `archive_task` | 归档任务（隐藏默认视图、不占容量、停止同步、清掉选中它的会话绑定；归档任务也不再参与注入与召回）。`select_task` 可恢复。 |
| `show_task_panel` | 在 UI 中打开任务面板。用户要求查看任务列表或你想展示面板时调用。 |
| `/tasks`（用户输入，不经模型） | 唯一的用户命令：展示任务栈并驱动工作流卡片。其余动作是它的**子动词**，由卡片按钮调用：`switch` / `archive` / `unbind` / `rename` / `todos …` / `step` / `step-move` / `step-text`
@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 用法：`/tasks` 在 web 的 `/` 菜单里以带图标的**「工作流」**组呈现 —— 三个视图入口：任务 / 项目记忆 / 全局记忆（标题随界面语言切换）。它是插件唯一注册的命令，其余动作全部作为它的子动词由卡片按钮驱动。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 工作原理：设计遵循四个原则：

- **易失性** — 上下文是临时的，会话压缩即丢失。
- **持久性** — **记忆**存于磁盘，跨压缩与会话保留。
- **紧凑性** — 代码层每个符号只存一行有界声明，文档层每个 chunk 保留 ≤300 字符的摘要与有界词项。doc→symbol 链接不落盘，读取期计算。
- **可核验性** — **召回**在适用时携带 `路径:行号` 引用，agent 可对照源文件核实。

默认开启懒索引时，构建**记忆**无需预先全量扫描：文件在模型读取时被记忆，**记忆**恰好覆盖实际处理过的内容；`index_repo` 或监听根可以覆盖其余文件。未变更的文件重读是空操作，因此持续维护开销很低。

项目级与任务级记忆按项目保存，并跟随代码库变化：文件变更按内容哈希重新抽取，文件删除则同步移除。经验笔记是 `insights.json` 里普通的 `kind: 'experience'` 条目：可检索、参与去重，也能进入与教训相同的受门槛约束的提示通道。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 设计：```
.dsh-project-memory/
  format.json      布局标记（v2，分片式）
  shards/          每个被索引源文件一个自描述 JSON —— 写入只落脏分片
  watch.json       被监听根目录

global 级条目不放在项目里：它们在 `insight.globalFile`（默认 `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`），所有项目共享。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 设计：- **增量** — 按文件内容哈希，仅重新抽取变更文件。
- **交叉链接** — `query_memory` 返回文档 chunk 时，按**当前**符号表解算它提到的符号，以 `references` 带出。文档先索引、符号后到也能链上。
- **查询扩展** — `llmQueryExpansion` 开启时，把查询改写为多个变体（同义词、中英、符号名猜测）再合并分数；关闭时查询完全不碰 LLM。索引本身不调用模型。
- **一致性** — 事实层跟随代码库（哈希重抽 / 删除即移除）；经验条目与其他 insight 走同一套覆盖与 `forget` 机制。写入在跨进程的目录锁（`.write.lock`）内做一次短暂的读改写，因此两个 dsh 实例可以共用一个项目存储：分片按 `indexedAt` 收敛，拿不到锁的保存会延后重试，仍失败则在退出时同步 flush；默认静默（`DSH_PROJECT_MEMORY_DEBUG=1` 才打印一行诊断）。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：**排除名单。** 以下目录不会作为根，精确匹配（子目录不受影响）：文件系统根、家目录、临时目录（`os.tmpdir()` 与共享的 `/tmp`、`/var/tmp`、`%TEMP%`、`%SystemRoot%\Temp`），以及系统/包管理器前缀（POSIX 上的 `/opt/homebrew`，Windows 上的 `%SystemRoot%`、`%ProgramFiles%`、`%ProgramData%`）。这些目录下的会话默认不启用记忆，stderr 输出一行说明。

**自定义根名单。** 在同一份配置的 `roots` 下可以覆盖上述判定；三项都支持 `~`/`~/...`，非绝对路径会被忽略并在 stderr 告警一次（相对路径按宿主 cwd 解释，不可预测），Windows 下大小写不敏感：

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：- `roots.allow`：即使命中了内置名单也允许作根，精确匹配；文件系统根不在此列。
- `roots.deny`：这个目录不能当根，精确匹配；它的子目录仍可各自成根。
- `roots.exclude`：这棵子树里的文件一律不进索引，按路径边界前缀匹配（含子目录）；也不能在这里推出新的根。父根的完整扫描会跳过它，并清理该子树里已索引的条目。

注意 `deny` 只决定这个目录自己能不能当根：父目录已经是根时，`deny` 的子目录仍会被父根索引——要连文件一起排除请用 `exclude`（或 `.gitignore`，git 仓库里的扫描本来就尊重它）。显式 `index_doc` 也服从 `exclude`，被排除的文件会返回 `Not indexed`。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：优先级是 `exclude` > `deny` > `allow` > 内置名单。`allowUnsafeRoots: true` 只放开内置名单，`deny` / `exclude` 仍然优先。生效面是同一套判定：显式工具调用、懒索引、watch、会话审计、任务桥。被当前策略拒绝的根会在下次启动时从 `watch.json` 摘掉。配置写在 `- id: project-memory` 的 `config:` 下。

**扫描上限。** 单次扫描最多 `maxScanFiles` 个文件（20000）、`maxScanDepth` 层目录（12）。被截断时，`index_repo` 的结果里会说明，watcher 每个根记一行，且不会删除没扫到的条目。**读不到的目录**（如 `EACCES`）同样算一次截断扫描并在结果里点名：读失败不等于被删除。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：**单文件内存预算。** `maxFileSizeMb` 管的是内存而不是磁盘偏好。索引一个文件要先把它整个物化——代码是整个 buffer 加解码后的正文，文档是逐页正文再加拼出来的 markdown——峰值随文件大小线性走。用 `npm run bench:peak` 实测（1–50 MB 阶梯，每档一个独立进程，对「峰值 RSS = a + b × 磁盘 MB」做最小二乘）：典型源码（约 1 个声明 / 1.4 KB）**≈10×**，符号密集的代码（1 个 / 220 B）**≈22×**，文本型 PDF **≈20×**；此外还有约 52 MB 的进程基线，以及首次解析 PDF 一次性约 175 MB 的底座。默认 10 MB 因此把单个文件的增量压在 **+300 MB RSS**（代码）/ **+370 MB**（PDF）量级；调大它就按比例抬高这个上限。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：store 建在被索引的目录树里，并且**自我忽略**：自己目录内的一条 `*` 规则让它不出现在 `git status` / `git add -A` 里，`git clean -fd` 也不会删它。确实想把记忆跟着仓库提交：`git add -f .dsh-project-memory`——已跟踪文件不受忽略规则影响。

配置存放在插件的 config 对象中。修改方式：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一条覆盖项——web profile 对应 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: project-memory
  config:
    lazyIndexing: true          # 开启：模型读到哪个文件就索引哪个（默认）
    autoIndexOnFirstUse: false  # 关闭：不做加载时的全量扫描（默认）

只需列出要改的键，其余键回落到插件默认值。用 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证生效。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 功能开关：**web profile 上有三个键同时提供可视化设置。** 位置是**插件 → 项目记忆 → 详情页 → 常用设置**（`plugins.bundle.config`，key 为包名）：`autoIndexOnFirstUse`、`watchInterval`（秒）、`llmQueryExpansion`。保存走宿主的 `settings` 接口——卡片始终是上面那份 profile 配置的投影，不另写文件。`watchInterval` 与 `llmQueryExpansion` 立即生效（轮询定时器当场重排，扩展开关每次查询时读取）；`autoIndexOnFirstUse` 是一次性启动动作，卡片上写明"下次启动生效"。其余旋钮——`memoryDir`、`roots.*`、扫描上限、insight / 反思 / 自动注入——**刻意留在 profile**：它们要么一改就换数据位置，要么需要理解上下文，三行卡片承载不了；后台监视也**不给开关**（关掉只会让记忆越来越旧）。宿主不提供 `slots` / `configForms` / `locale` 时卡片零注册，并打一条点名原因的告警，而不是静默消失。这三个键在插件装配期解析，所以**升级后需要重启一次 dsh**（在卡片里保存则无需重启）。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 真实项目实测（2026-10-13）：四个语料、同一台 Linux 机器（Node 24.19），每个跑两遍、引用**第二次（页缓存已热）**的数据。「冷索引」= 完整索引一轮（walk + 哈希 + 抽取 + 落盘）；「查询」= 线上同一套 scorer 跑 100 条采样；「单文件重索引」= watch 的重索引内核（读 + 抽取 + 落盘），不含懒索引的根解析 / `.gitignore` 固定开销。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 真实项目实测（2026-10-13）：**扩展形状。** 重索引一个变更文件的成本是 O(文件)、不是 O(语料)——上面每个语料都在 0.3–7.2 ms。冷加载（≈22 µs/文件）、查询（最大语料 ≈0.5 µs/条目）与常驻堆（查询一次后 ≈1.5 KB/条目）随索引规模线性增长，因此小型与中型项目都落在个位数毫秒。重复读一个已索引文件约 0.01 ms：一次 `stat` 加一次缓存命中的记录查询就结束，不读盘、不哈希、也不起 `git check-ignore`。

> `read+hash` 受操作系统页缓存影响——12,634 文件时冷缓存 2.3 s、热缓存 0.27 s——上表引用的是热缓存那一遍。

@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory README · 设计取舍：- **短时文件锁，而不是嵌入式数据库** — 每次保存只在读改写期间持有排他的 `.write.lock`（解析在锁外完成），对方忙时最多**同步等 15s**（写路径的正确性靠等到锁，不靠后台重试）；仍失败会登记进退出 flush，关 dsh / 卸载插件时再同步写一次。全程**默认不打扰用户**——记忆写入幂等、失败成本低；需要排查时设 `DSH_PROJECT_MEMORY_DEBUG=1` 才会打印一行。锁内容带 `pid` / `host` / `token`：同机持有者活着就绝不抢，release 校验所有权、不删别人的锁；崩溃残留的同机死锁按 pid 立即回收。两个 dsh 实例因此可以共用一个存储。没有 WAL、没有常驻进程、没有原生依赖。
- **Watch：事务外计算，事务内提交** — 不持锁解析，也不用 `fs.watch`：轮询 + mtime/内容哈希在网络盘、Docker 卷、WSL 上行为一致，没有 `fs.watch` 的重复触发/漏事件问题。
- **损坏分片隔离，不自动修复** — 解析失败的分片改名、只重索引该文件；不引入 WAL 或嵌入式数据库，那会带来原生依赖、锁竞争与它们自己的新故障模式。
- **向量只重排，不做排序主力** — 在**改写成不含原词**的查询集上，纯向量替换差于 BM25（hit@10 **53% vs 69%**），加权融合只在**小 k** 上更好（hit@3 **53% vs 50%**），所以可选层只重排经验/洞察两层、绝不参与闸门。词法检索在本插件针对的查询上依然够用：真实项目 29 条标注查询的文件级 hit@5 为 **96.6%**，整 chunk 词项把文档词项覆盖从 **27.3% 提到 100%** 且 MRR 不变（**0.958** vs **0.955**）。
- **索引确定且不调用模型** — 索引期不调模型、查询期也不翻译：前者会让同一份文档两次索引结果不同，后者有一个硬失败模式（译错 = 零召回）；规则 + 符号链接已经覆盖常见情况，且离线可用。
- **面向模型的记忆：agent 自己写，不把人放进回路** — 记忆的消费方是 agent，而 agent 通常是无头的，只在有人点卡片时才升级的记忆等于永远不会升级。`draft` 是「来源标记 + 佐证门槛」而不是审批队列。
- **直接返回完整条目** — 条目本就紧凑，完整返回更可核验，也少一轮往返。
- **`forget` 按关键词激进；精确请用 ID** — 经验笔记低风险、高量，陈旧噪音比误删更伤。精确删用 `query_memory` 输出里的 ID。
